app.name: Converter Studio
app.short_description: Convert ticket attachments: HEIC to JPG, MOV to MP4, DOCX to PDF and more
app.long_description:
**Converter Studio** turns the files customers send into files your team can open. In the ticket sidebar it lists the ticket's attachments and converts the one you pick: iPhone HEIC photos to JPG, MKV, MOV and AVI videos to MP4, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files to PDF, PDFs to Word or to a smaller PDF, screenshots and scans to text, camera RAW photos, ebooks, audio and more than 60 formats in all.

**How it works**  

1. Open a ticket and find Converter Studio in the apps sidebar.
2. Pick what an attachment should become and click Convert.
3. Download the result or open it in a new tab. To keep it on the ticket, attach it to a reply or an internal note.  

The original attachment is never changed or removed.

**What you need**

A [Converter Studio](https://converter.studio) account and an API key. Conversions use the account's credits: a free account gets a few credits every day, and most files cost 1 credit. See [plans and credit packs](https://converter.studio/pricing). An admin sets the most credits one conversion may use; a dearer conversion is refused and nothing is charged.

**About Converter Studio**

Converter Studio is a file conversion service for the web, desktop and mobile, with a [public API](https://converter.studio/developers) that this app uses.

**Your data**

- When an agent converts an attachment, Converter Studio's server downloads that one file from its Zendesk link (or, if your Zendesk requires a sign-in for attachments, receives it from the agent's browser), converts it, deletes the original once it is converted and the result after 6 hours.
- The app reads the ticket's attachment list and one account setting (whether attachments require a sign-in) with the agent's own Zendesk session. It sends Converter Studio nothing else: no ticket text, no customer or agent details. It never writes to the ticket.
- Zendesk stores the API key as a secure setting and sends it only to converter.studio; agents never see it.
- [Privacy policy](https://converter.studio/privacy) · [Terms](https://converter.studio/terms) · Support: support@converter.studio
app.installation_instructions:
1. Sign in to [Converter Studio](https://converter.studio) (or create a free account) and make an API key on your [account page](https://converter.studio/account#api-keys).
2. In the Zendesk Marketplace, click Install and choose your Zendesk account.
3. Paste the key into **Converter Studio API key**.
4. Optionally change **Most credits one conversion may use** (10 by default; most files cost 1 credit).
5. Choose which roles or groups may use the app, if you want to, and click **Install**.  

The app then shows in the ticket sidebar of every ticket. If your Zendesk requires a sign-in to download attachments, agents save an attachment first and choose the saved file in the app.
